'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Kevin Jaap LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Jaap]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Jaap]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
